title: SuperSport 950 S (Enduro Spec)
description: The Ducati SuperSport 950 S (Enduro Spec) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 50cc engine generating 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
